**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (preferred level).**

- **Section 13.1 (p0627)** fixes the term as commencing on the Effective Date and continuing, Product-by-Product and country-by-country, until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term. There is no automatic renewal, no rolling term, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift language.
- **Section 14.4 (p0672)** expressly provides that post-expiry orders or licences are not "a renewal or extension hereof," so any continuation requires a fresh mutual written agreement — the preferred position.
- The conditional automatic-renewal elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder) and the CPI/3% price cap are untriggered because renewal is not automatic and no renewal pricing exists.
- Expiry is also favourable to us: Ono's Section 2.1 licences convert to non-exclusive, perpetual, fully paid-up, royalty-free licences with sublicensing rights.

No redline proposed.
